slides.title: The Residual Revolution: ResNet 🏆
slides.content:
# The Degradation Problem & Skip Connections

Before 2015, making CNNs deeper caused accuracy to degrade due to vanishing gradients during backpropagation.

He et al. introduced **Residual Networks (ResNet)** with **Skip (Shortcut) Connections**:

$$
\mathcal{H}(x) = \mathcal{F}(x) + x
$$

```
            x
          /   \
         |     [ Weight Layer ]
         |           |
         |     [ ReLU Activation ]
         |           |
         |     [ Weight Layer ]
          \   /
            +   <-- Element-wise addition
            |
         [ ReLU ]
```

Instead of learning the entire mapping $\mathcal{H}(x)$, the network only learns the **residual** $\mathcal{F}(x)$. The identity shortcut lets gradients flow directly backward through hundreds of layers without attenuation!

slides.title: Transfer Learning Superpower 🚀
slides.content:
## Never Train From Scratch Unless Necessary
Models like ResNet-50 trained on ImageNet (1.4 million images, 1000 classes) have already learned universal visual features (edges, textures, shapes).

To build a custom classifier (e.g. classifying 5 types of plants):
1. Download the pre-trained backbone.
2. Freeze the convolutional weights.
3. Replace only the final dense classification head with your custom classes.
4. Fine-tune on your modest dataset!
